page: Microsoft Azure M32bds_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MBDSMediumMemoryv3 family. It is powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8473C x86_64 processor running at 4.0 GHz, featuring 16 physical cores and 32 vCPUs via hyperthreading. The server is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It includes 410 GB of local storage and supports Premium Storage.

Benchmark data indicates strong single-core and text processing capabilities, with Geekbench single-core and text processing scores placing in the top 10% tier. Multi-threaded operations also show high performance, with bzip3 decompression and static web serving throughput ranking in the top 25%. However, while small-model LLM text generation is strong, large-model text generation is a notable bottleneck, performing in the bottom 25% due to the lack of dedicated GPU acceleration.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the M32bds_v3 offers a dense memory profile and dedicated compute resources suitable for memory-intensive enterprise workloads without the overhead of GPU hardware. This makes it a balanced choice for large-scale databases, memory-cached web serving, data decompression pipelines, and moderate-scale text processing tasks.
